comments.content: This call to `generateSignedCertificate` now passes `days` as the `signatureAlgorithm` argument because the overload with `(principal, san, keyPair, caCert, caPrivKey, days, signatureAlgorithm)` was removed. The `days` value is an `int` and will be autoboxed to `Integer`, but the parameter type is `String`, so this will not compile. It should likely be `null` for the signature algorithm, or the call should be updated to use the new overload with `keyUsage` and `extendedKeyUsages`.
